# Shift Pre-Service Lineup Briefing: Table 14 Dietary Service Plan
Service Date: 05/18/2026 | Shift: Dinner (18:30 Cover) | Station: 4 | Server: Marcus Vance

## Party Profile and Allergy Roster
| Guest Seat | Primary Diet / Severe Allergies | Wine Preference |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Seat 1 (Host) | None; prefers dry red wine | Cabernet Sauvignon |
| Seat 2 | Celiac disease (strict gluten-free, no cross-contact) | Sparkling water |
| Seat 3 | Severe tree nut anaphylaxis (carries EpiPen) | Pinot Noir |
| Seat 4 | Strict vegan (no dairy, egg, honey, meat) | Chardonnay |

## Menu Verbal Presentation Notes
- Seat 1 features the 14 oz Prime Dry-Aged Ribeye ($68) served with charred shallot compound butter and garlic confit fingerlings.
- For Seat 2, suggest the Pan-Seared Halibut with sweet corn emulsion and blistered heirloom tomatoes, prepared using a sanitized dedicated pan.
- For Seat 3, recommend the Wild Forest Mushroom Risotto, which features carnaroli rice, black truffles, and shaved toasted hazelnuts garnish.
- Present the catch of the day special: Wild King Salmon served over baby spinach with lemon dill emulsion.

## Beverage Service and Up-Selling Protocol
- When presenting wine pairings, present the 2021 Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon bottle at tableside to Seat 1, verifying label and vintage before opening.
- Offer dessert menus after main clearing; remind kitchen to execute all Seat 2 and Seat 3 items on red-marked tickets.

errors.quote: recommend the Wild Forest Mushroom Risotto, which features carnaroli rice, black truffles, and shaved toasted hazelnuts garnish.
errors.explanation: Seat 3 has a documented severe tree nut anaphylaxis, but the server guide directs Marcus to recommend a dish garnished with toasted hazelnuts, which are tree nuts.
errors.fix: recommend the Wild Forest Mushroom Risotto with shaved black truffles, omitting the toasted hazelnut garnish to keep it strictly tree nut-free.

errors.quote: Present the catch of the day special: Wild King Salmon served over baby spinach with lemon dill emulsion.
errors.explanation: The daily catch special verbal presentation omits the market price or dish cost, which must be provided to guests when verbally introducing daily food specials.
errors.fix: Present the catch of the day special: Wild King Salmon served over baby spinach with lemon dill emulsion at $44.
